law: Closures are TIGHTEN-ONLY: evaluated after the frozen decision table, they may move VALID to a defect class and may never weaken or reorder a frozen classification. Each closure states the caller-supplied consistency it enforces. Operators are the frozen predicate vocabulary plus PROJECTION_NE, DERIVED_DIFF_NE, ROW_FIELD_NE_ON_FLAG and EDGE_ENDPOINTS_NOT_SUBSET (defined in rr_api.py). A closure that references a required fact field by value is what makes that field's register status 'semantic_closure'; one that references it only for presence makes it 'presence_only_closure'. lint_contract.py L4 checks that correspondence in both directions, so a closure cannot be added or removed without the register moving with it.

OBL-08.statement: assumption_ids is a set of distinct assumption identifiers; a repeated identifier presents one assumption as two and makes the declared assumption base uncountable.

OBL-12.statement: subject_id, information_type, context_id and purpose_id are the contextual parameters the transmission is assessed against; a null parameter means the caller never stated it, so the assessment ran over an unstated context. The frozen table already treats a null transmission_principle as a defect; these four carry the same weight.

OBL-14.statement: every parent_edges and dependency_edges endpoint must appear in node_ids; a graph whose edges reference undeclared nodes means the frozen self-loop and acyclicity checks ran over a graph larger than the one the caller declared.
node_ids is a set of distinct node identifiers; a repeated identifier makes the declared node set disagree with its own count.

OBL-16.statement: support, provenance and authority records must be distinct records where non-null; reusing one record as two of the three presents a single basis as two independent ones. OBL-04 classifies exactly this relation over the same three field names.
missing_evidence_ids is the caller's own record of evidence it does not hold; a handoff carried out while that list is non-empty is incomplete on the caller's own account.
obligation_ids and assumption_ids are sets of distinct identifiers; a repeated identifier inflates the declared obligation or assumption base without adding one.

OBL-22.statement: one object cannot be both an authenticated binding and self-asserted trust: an equal SHA-256 is equal bytes, so an intersection places one evidence object in two mutually exclusive trust classes. Not treating self-asserted trust as a binding is this obligation's subject.
each evidence digest list is a set of distinct objects; a repeated digest counts one byte-object twice and inflates the apparent evidence base.

OBL-24.statement: covered_modality_ids is a set of distinct modality identifiers; a repeated identifier inflates declared coverage without covering another modality.

OBL-30.statement: compatible_record_ids must equal the set of record_ids whose supplied compatibility verdict is true; a projection that contradicts its own verdict rows is a conflict, not a valid selection basis.
incompatible_record_ids must equal the set of record_ids whose supplied compatibility verdict is false.

undispositioned_compatible_record_ids must equal compatible_record_ids minus selected_record_ids minus excluded_record_ids — derived, never trusted: a stale selected set can no longer pass with empty caller-asserted bookkeeping.
a record the caller declares compatible must carry the declared intent episode; the caller's own candidate_pool row saying otherwise contradicts the verdict it supplied.
a record the caller declares compatible must carry the declared intent purpose.
a record the caller declares compatible must carry the declared intent scope.
a record the caller declares compatible must carry the declared intent action class.
a record the caller declares compatible must carry the declared intent version digest.
